page_title: JUV 2-0 GEN | Juventus v Genoa 06/04/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The match has just finished.
90+4' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Juventus.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
90' The game has come to an end for Kenan Yildiz. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Jeremie Boga (Juventus).
89' Emil Holm (Juventus) outjumps his marker and heads the resulting corner high over the bar.
88' Corner kick. Juventus will have an opportunity.
88' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
87' Patrizio Masini (Genoa) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Davide Massa stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
84' The resulting set piece from Juventus is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
83' Substitution. Morten Frendrup leaves the pitch and is replaced by Jeff Ekhator (Genoa).
83' Luciano Spalletti decides to make a substitution. Andrea Cambiaso will be replaced by Emil Holm (Juventus).
83' Here comes a substitution. Fabio Miretti (Juventus) is brought on as a substitute for Francisco Conceicao.
82' Arkadiusz Milik (Juventus) has a sight of goal and shoots from long range but his ambitious effort flies just wide of the right post.
81' Patrizio Masini (Genoa) latches onto a great cross but heads straight at Mattia Perin, who makes a comfortable save.
80' Aaron Martin (Genoa) tries to get the ball up and over the defensive wall, but they easily block the effort.
79' Genoa win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
78' Khephren Thuram (Juventus) is shown a yellow card after a horrible tackle.
78' Davide Massa blows his whistle as Arkadiusz Milik (Juventus) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.

76' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Aaron Martin (Genoa) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the left side of the goal, but Mattia Perin pulls off a brilliant save.
75' Aaron Martin (Genoa) wastes a huge opportunity to score from the penalty spot. He attempts to slot into the left side of the target, but Mattia Perin pulls off a superb save.
75' Aaron Martin (Genoa) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
75' It’s a PENALTY to Genoa after the VAR review!
73' Referee Davide Massa makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Genoa. Let’s see what happens!
73' Genoa are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
72' Bremer (Juventus) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Davide Massa didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
70' Tommaso Baldanzi (Genoa) runs onto the ball and hits a thunderbolt of a shot at goal from the edge of the box, but sends it narrowly wide of the right post.
68' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Genoa will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
67' Substitution. Jonathan David makes his way off the pitch and Arkadiusz Milik (Juventus) comes on as his replacement.
66' Here is a change. Lorenzo Colombo is going off and Daniele De Rossi gives the last tactical orders to Caleb Ekuban (Genoa).
66' Ruslan Malinovskyi goes off the pitch and Patrizio Masini (Genoa) comes on.
65' Leo Ostigard (Genoa) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Mattia Perin, who smothers the ball.
56' The corner from Aaron Martin (Genoa) is hurriedly cleared.
56' Vitinha (Genoa) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. Genoa earn a corner.
55' Genoa have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

54' What a goal-scoring opportunity! Aaron Martin (Genoa) makes a good run into the box to meet a cross and fires the ball in on goal, but the shot is amazingly blocked by a defender. Genoa force a corner. They send men into the box.
53' Mattia Perin blocks Tommaso Baldanzi (Genoa)'s effort from the edge of the box.
52' Daniele De Rossi has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Tommaso Baldanzi (Genoa) replacing Junior Messias.
51' Davide Massa shows a yellow card to Morten Frendrup (Genoa) for a tough tackle.
50' A pass by Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
48' POST! Jonathan David (Juventus) unleashes a thunderous effort from the edge of the box and the ball crashes against the left post. What a strike that was!

47' Weston McKennie (Juventus) wasted a huge opportunity! He received a fine cross from the free kick and fired a decent shot in from close range. Unfortunately for him, it sailed narrowly wide of the left post!
46' Mattia Perin (Juventus) is substituted due to injury. Luciano Spalletti gives a chance to Michele Di Gregorio.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+2' Davide Massa has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
45' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) takes a shot on goal, but his effort isn't precise enough and it flies a whisker wide of the left post.
43' Kenan Yildiz plays a through ball to Weston McKennie (Juventus) inside the box, he has time and arrows at shot that just goes over the bar. That really was a good chance!
40' The foul by Khephren Thuram (Juventus) was seen by Davide Massa who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
38' Genoa seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.

34' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and smashes a glorious looking effort towards the right side of the goal, but Justin Bijlow thwarts him with a great two-handed save.
32' Juventus enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
30' The free kick is delivered by Aaron Martin (Genoa) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared.
28' Vitinha (Genoa) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
28' Aaron Martin (Genoa) takes the free kick and immediately restarts play with a short pass.
26' Davide Massa shows a yellow card to Weston McKennie (Juventus) for his blatant foul.
26' Leo Ostigard (Genoa) unleashes a shot, but his effort is poor and flies well wide of the left post.
26' Genoa take a short corner kick.
24' Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) fires the ball on goal, but his attempt goes well wide of the left post.
21' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked.
21' Juventus quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
20' Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence. The ball goes out of play. Juventus are awarded a corner kick.
20' Khephren Thuram (Juventus) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
17' 2 - 0 Weston McKennie (Juventus) collects a sweet pass and fires a low shot into the bottom left corner. What a goal!
16' Aaron Martin (Genoa) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.

16' Ruslan Malinovskyi (Genoa) tries to bend in the free kick from distance, but the defensive wall makes an easy block. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Genoa.
15' Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) picks up a yellow card.
13' Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.
12' Morten Frendrup (Genoa) handles the ball inside the penalty area. Juventus win a free kick.
9' Great teamplay by Juventus as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
8' Khephren Thuram (Juventus) bends the ball in from the edge of the box which worries the keeper, but it eventually sails just wide of the left post.
4' 1 - 0 Bremer (Juventus) gets on the scoresheet with a sweet header that goes inside the right post!
4' A quickly taken corner by Juventus.
3' Kenan Yildiz (Juventus) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out. The referee blows his whistle, Juventus are awarded a corner kick.
